source.licence: MIT (derived from publisher-declared MIT TinyStories weights); original corpus MIT OR Apache-2.0
notices: Local FFN fitting on refreshed student trajectories; no whole-decoder training.
Dataset provenance and pinned CDLA-Sharing-1.0 source notices retained; no pretraining overlap exclusion.

limits: 48 attributed prefixes in the TinyStories genre, not a broad benchmark.
Split independence is by exact source story and normalized prefix; semantic near-duplicates and model pretraining overlap remain unknown.
Training uses capped train trajectories; validation selects; all-candidate test reports are diagnostic only.
Actual packages retain original weights; fewer effective parameters do not mean disk/RSS savings.
Timings apply to the recorded scalar-f64 host/executable/workload; no native/GPU/parallel guarantee.

selection.rule: quality delta and actual package budgets; candidate p95 strictly below dense minimum; among eligible lowest median then NLL then plan ID; otherwise dense

source.selection: SHA-256 order, 48 distinct normalized prefixes, 384 source UTF-8 bytes at character boundaries, 24/12/12 split
